title: Intent Stance Classes
description: Stance and motivation classes used by the reviewer.

entries.title: Factual Intent
entries.description: A literal or report-like intent that presents information.

entries.title: Evaluative Intent
entries.description: An intent that judges, praises, warns, or criticizes.

entries.title: Coercive Intent
entries.description: An intent that pressures or forces behavior.

entries.title: Expressive Intent
entries.description: An intent shown through humor, sarcasm, or irony.

entries.title: Fictional Intent
entries.description: An intent framed as story, acting, dream, or fantasy.

entries.title: Corrective Intent
entries.description: An intent that clarifies or corrects an earlier misunderstanding.

entries.title: Confessional Intent
entries.description: An intent that reveals or admits something.

entries.title: Questioning Intent
entries.description: An intent that seeks clarification rather than asserting meaning.
